strings.Odejście z pracy z dnia na dzień — kiedy: Leaving a job overnight — when can an employee receive compensation?
strings.Data publikacji: 25 lipca 2026 · Autor:: Published: 25 July 2026 · Author: Dariusz Włodarczyk Kancelaria TRC · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.Zdarza się, że pracodawca przestaje wypł: It happens that an employer stops paying wages, grossly breaches health and safety rules or otherwise seriously violates an employee's rights. In such situations the Labour Code allows you to leave the job immediately — without notice — and to claim compensation. Below we explain when and on what terms this is possible.
strings.<a href=\"#kiedy\">Kiedy pracownik może: When an employee may leave without notice
strings.<a href=\"#odszkodowanie\">Jakie odszkod: What compensation the employee is entitled to
strings.<a href=\"#pismo\">O czym pamiętać przed: What to remember before submitting the letter
strings.<a href=\"#ryzyko\">Uwaga: pracodawca ta: Note: the employer can also defend itself
strings.1. Kiedy pracownik może odejść bez wypow: 1. When an employee may leave without notice
strings.Pracownik może rozwiązać umowę o pracę b: An employee may terminate the employment contract without notice if the employer has committed a serious breach of its basic obligations towards the employee (Article 55 § 11 of the Labour Code). In practice this mainly means persistent non-payment of wages, significant delays in payment, serious breaches of health and safety rules or other particularly gross violations of employee rights.
strings.<strong>Dotyczy także cudzoziemców.</str: This also applies to foreigners. The right to terminate a contract under Article 55 of the Labour Code belongs to every employee working under an employment contract, regardless of citizenship. A separate issue is the effect of the end of employment on the validity of a work or residence permit — this should be planned before leaving.
strings.2. Jakie odszkodowanie przysługuje praco: 2. What compensation the employee is entitled to
strings.Jeżeli rozwiązanie umowy w trybie art. 5: If terminating the contract under Article 55 of the Labour Code was justified, the employee may claim compensation equal to the remuneration for the notice period. For contracts concluded for an indefinite and for a fixed term, the compensation corresponds to the remuneration for the notice period, and if the contract was concluded for a shorter fixed term — for the period until the contract was to last, but no more than for the notice period. This means that leaving overnight does not have to mean losing the money that would correspond to an ordinary notice period.
strings.3. O czym pamiętać przed złożeniem pisma: 3. What to remember before submitting the letter
strings.Oświadczenie o rozwiązaniu umowy powinno: The declaration terminating the contract should be submitted in writing, stating the reason justifying the termination. It is worth keeping a copy of the document and gathering evidence of the employer's breaches.
strings.korespondencja z pracodawcą (e-maile, wi: correspondence with the employer (e-mails, messages, payment demands),
strings.potwierdzenia przelewów i paski wynagrod: confirmations of transfers and payslips showing missing or delayed payments,
strings.notatki dotyczące warunków pracy, zgłosz: notes on working conditions, health and safety reports, documentation of the state of the workstation.
strings.<strong>Termin.</strong> Rozwiązanie umo: Deadline. Termination of the contract without notice through the fault of the employer may not take place more than 1 month after the employee learns of the circumstance justifying the termination (Article 55 § 2 in conjunction with Article 52 § 2 of the Labour Code). Do not delay your decision for too long.
strings.4. Uwaga: pracodawca także może się bron: 4. Note: the employer can also defend itself
strings.Jeżeli pracownik <strong>bezzasadnie</st: If an employee invokes Article 55 of the Labour Code without justification, the employer may claim compensation of its own. That is why, before taking a decision, it is worth checking carefully whether the breaches really are serious and whether they can be proved. Whether a breach is "serious" can be a matter of dispute — in case of doubt it is safer to consult a lawyer before submitting the declaration.

strings.Sprawdzimy Twoją umowę, ocenimy ryzyko i: We will check your contract, assess the risk and help you prepare the declaration terminating the contract — so as to protect your rights and, if you are a foreigner, your residence status.

The worst part is that the foreigner is often the last to learn about the problem — when the case is already closed. If your correspondence is collected by your employer or an agency, this article may save you from losing your legal stay. strings.1. Dlaczego wezwanie z urzędu mogło do C: 1. Why the summons from the office may not have reached you
strings.Jeśli w sprawie działa pełnomocnik, urzą: If a representative acts in the case, the office serves documents on them — not on you (Art. 40 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure, KPA). When the representative is your employer or an agency, the summons to supplement the formal deficiencies of the application goes to the company, and the time limit runs regardless of whether anyone passed it on to you.
strings.<strong>To nie jest wina urzędu.</strong: This is not the office's fault. From the procedural point of view, service on the representative is effective. That is why it matters so much WHO your representative is and whether they really look after your case.
strings.2. Co grozi, gdy minie termin na uzupełn: 2. What happens when the deadline to supplement formal deficiencies expires?
strings.Organ może pozostawić wniosek bez rozpoz: The authority may leave the application without examination (Art. 64 § 2 KPA). The case is then not decided on the merits — as if the application had never been filed. In residence cases this may mean the loss of the basis for legal stay and the need to rebuild your situation from scratch.
strings.3. Co robić, jeśli termin już minął?: 3. What to do if the deadline has already passed?
strings.ustal natychmiast stan sprawy: numer, or: establish the status of the case immediately: the file number, the authority handling it, what was sent and when,

strings.nie wysyłaj pism „z wzoru\" bez analizy: do not send letters „from a template” without analysis — an ill-considered letter may close doors that are still open.
strings.O tym, jakie środki przysługują (ponagle: We write in detail about the available remedies (ponaglenie — a formal reminder urging the authority to act, and a complaint about inaction) and how to use them in the next part of the series: an application left without examination — how to save the case.
strings.4. Jak nie dopuścić do takiej sytuacji?: 4. How to prevent such a situation?
strings.Zadbaj, by korespondencja w Twojej spraw: Make sure the correspondence in your case reaches you or a representative who acts solely in your interest and reports every move of the office to you. If your case is currently handled by a company, read our comparison: lawyer or employer and what to do when the employer will not return your documents.
strings.Czy urząd musi zawiadamiać mnie osobiści: Must the office notify me personally if I have a representative?
strings.Nie. Jeżeli ustanowiono pełnomocnika, pi: No. If a representative has been appointed, documents are served on the representative (Art. 40 § 2 KPA) and such service is effective towards you.

strings.Nie — to zakończenie sprawy bez oceny me: No — it is the closing of the case without an assessment on the merits. The way of responding differs from an appeal against a decision; see the next article in the series on saving such a case.

strings.Wielu cudzoziemców orientuje się zbyt pó: Many foreigners realise far too late that they have no access to the most important documents in their own residence card case. In this article we show how to recover residence card documents effectively and without going to war with your employer.

Without the documents it is harder to answer a summons from the authority, apply for a change of permit or show continuity of employment. In the worst case the matter ends with the application being left without examination — we wrote about this in the article what to do when the employer does not return your documents.

This is not a minor inconvenience — without them you may fail to answer a summons from the authority, be unable to change jobs and genuinely lose your legal stay. strings.1. Dlaczego brak dokumentów od pracodawc: 1. Why is the lack of documents from your employer dangerous for your residence card?
strings.Wniosek o pobyt czasowy i pracę opiera s: An application for temporary residence and work is based on employment documents: the contract, the employer's annex, confirmations of registration with ZUS. When you have no access to them, you lose control over your own case — and in residence proceedings time matters. A summons to remedy formal shortcomings has a strict deadline, and missing it may mean that the application is left without examination (Article 64 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Procedure).
strings.<strong>Pamiętaj:</strong> dokumenty dot: Remember: documents concerning your employment and your residence case concern you. You have the right to copies of them — regardless of how your relations with the company are going.
strings.2. Co robić krok po kroku, gdy pracodawc: 2. What to do step by step when the employer withholds documents?
strings.Działaj spokojnie, ale konsekwentnie i z: Act calmly, but consistently and always in writing:
strings.poproś pracodawcę <strong>na piśmie</str: ask the employer in writing (an e-mail is enough) to release all documents concerning your employment and your residence case,
strings.zachowaj wiadomości, e-maile i zrzuty ek: keep messages, e-mails and screenshots of conversations — this is evidence in case of a dispute,
strings.zrób listę braków: umowa, załącznik prac: make a list of what is missing: the contract, the employer's annex to the application, confirmation of filing the application (UPO), payslips, ZUS registration,
strings.nie czekaj, jeśli firma unika odpowiedzi: do not wait if the company avoids answering — every week of delay works against you,
strings.przy świadectwie pracy pamiętaj, że jego: as for the work certificate, remember that issuing it is the employer's obligation under Article 97 of the Labour Code.
strings.3. Czy prawnik dla cudzoziemca odzyska d: 3. Will a lawyer for foreigners recover the documents faster?
strings.Zwykle tak. Formalne wezwanie od pełnomo: Usually yes. A formal request from a legal representative works differently from an employee's request — it shows that the matter is being monitored and that continuing to withhold the documents creates risk for the company. An independent lawyer will also assess immediately whether your case requires a new application, a change of permit or a letter to the authority — before the deadline passes. If you are planning to change jobs, remember the obligation to notify the voivode within 15 working days of losing your job (Act on Foreigners; the exact numbering of the provision should be verified against the current text of the act).
strings.<strong>Termin 15 dni.</strong> Po utrac: The 15-day deadline. After losing your job the clock is ticking regardless of whether you have the documents. Failing to notify on time may weigh on your residence case.
strings.4. Jak się zabezpieczyć na przyszłość?: 4. How to protect yourself in the future?
strings.Najbezpieczniejszy układ jest prosty: pr: The safest arrangement is simple: the employer provides the certificates, and the whole case is handled by a representative independent of the company — then the documents and correspondence are always with you. If you are wondering whom to entrust with your case, see our comparison: who should handle your residence card — a lawyer or an employer. strings.Od ustalenia faktów, nie od pisania pism: By establishing the facts, not by writing letters. You need: the case number, the content of the summons, the method and date of delivery, and information on what exactly was missing. You have the right to inspect the file and obtain copies (Article 73 of the Code of Administrative Procedure) — this is the foundation of any strategy.

strings.2. Ponaglenie, skarga czy nowy wniosek —: 2. Reminder, complaint or a new application — what to choose?
strings.Jeżeli kwestionujesz prawidłowość pozost: If you contest the correctness of leaving the application without examination, one option is a ponaglenie (a formal reminder urging the authority to act, Article 37 of the Code of Administrative Procedure), and once that route is exhausted — a complaint about inaction or excessive length of proceedings to the voivodeship administrative court. Where service was defective, you can argue that it was ineffective. And sometimes the fastest route is simply a new, complete application — the decision depends on the deadlines and your current basis of residence.

strings.Cudzoziemiec (w wyroku: A. U.) uzyskał s: The foreigner (in the judgment: A. U.) obtained refugee status by a decision of the President of the Office for Repatriation and Foreigners of November 2005. Together with that decision he was issued a travel document provided for in the Geneva Convention and a residence card. On 15 December 2005 he applied to the district family assistance centre for assistance under the integration programme, and on 20 December — in view of the expiry of the statutory time limit — he additionally filed an application for restoration of the time limit, claiming that the failure had occurred through no fault of his own.
strings.Prezydent miasta (organ I instancji) pos: The city mayor (the first-instance authority) refused to restore the time limit by a decision of February 2006, pointing to a lack of particular diligence. In his complaint the foreigner argued that he is a young man who fled persecution, does not speak Polish, had no experience in dealing with public authorities and had not been instructed about the 14-day time limit; he took action immediately after obtaining the information from an acquaintance.
strings.2. Naruszenia — na czym pomyliły się org: 2. Infringements — where the authorities went wrong
strings.Samorządowe Kolegium Odwoławcze rozpozna: Hearing the complaint, the Local Government Board of Appeal set aside the first-instance decision and discontinued the proceedings, considering them devoid of purpose. The Board rightly classified the 14-day time limit as a peremptory time limit of substantive law (which delimits the exercise of an entitlement and, as a rule, cannot be restored under Articles 58 and 59 of the Code of Administrative Procedure). The problem is that from a correct substantive assessment the authority drew an erroneous procedural conclusion.
strings.<strong>Bezpodstawne umorzenie postępowa: Unfounded discontinuation of the proceedings. Since the first-instance decision was based on an incorrect basis (a procedural provision on restoration of a time limit), the Board should have set it aside and issued a refusal based on the proper substantive basis — Article 91(3) of the Social Assistance Act — using its power to rule on the merits (correspondingly Article 138 § 1(2) in conjunction with Article 144 of the Code of Administrative Procedure), rather than discontinuing the proceedings as devoid of purpose. The court held that discontinuing the first-instance proceedings while hearing a complaint against a decision of an incidental nature is in principle inadmissible.
strings.<strong>Naruszenie art. 77 § 1 k.p.a.</s: Infringement of Article 77 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Procedure. The administrative file contained no proof of service of the decision granting refugee status — the date of service was established solely on the basis of the party’s statement. The court found this contrary to the duty to gather and consider the evidence exhaustively.
strings.<strong>Termin zawity, nie procesowy.</s: A peremptory, not a procedural time limit. The court confirmed that the 14-day time limit under Article 91(3) of the Social Assistance Act is a time limit of substantive law — its effective expiry makes it impossible to exercise the entitlement, and restoration is possible only exceptionally, where the provision setting the time limit expressly so provides. The court rejected the argument that it is “impossible” to gather the documents within 14 days: the necessary documents (including the decision and the residence card) are received by the refugee together with the decision granting status.
strings.Sąd uznał skargę za zasadną, choć części: The court held the complaint to be well-founded, albeit partly for reasons other than those raised in it (an administrative court is not bound by the allegations and requests of the complaint or by its legal basis — Article 134 § 1 of the Law on Proceedings before Administrative Courts). In its operative part, the Provincial Administrative Court in Warsaw:
strings.uchylił zaskarżone postanowienie Samorzą: set aside the contested decision of the Local Government Board of Appeal and the preceding decision of the city mayor;
strings.stwierdził, że zaskarżone postanowienie: held that the contested decision is not enforceable.
strings.Podstawą wyroku były art. 145 § 1 pkt 1: The judgment was based on Article 145 § 1(1)(a) and (c), Article 152 and Article 200 of the Law on Proceedings before Administrative Courts. At the same time the court indicated to the authorities the direction for re-examining the case: when re-examining the application for restoration of the time limit, it must be taken into account that the time limit under Article 91(3) of the Social Assistance Act is a peremptory time limit of substantive law.
strings.Praktyczny wniosek dla osób ze statusem: The practical conclusion for people with refugee status remains valid despite the passage of years: time limits for filing applications in foreigners’ cases are often peremptory time limits which simply cannot be “recovered” — even by invoking absence of fault, lack of knowledge of the language or lack of instruction. The risk of losing the entitlement is real and often irreversible.
strings.Wyrok pokazuje też drugą stronę: nawet g: The judgment also shows the other side: even where the authority’s position on the merits is correct, an error in the form of the ruling (discontinuation instead of refusal) leads to the decision being set aside. For a party this means it is worth examining not only “am I right”, but also “did the authority apply the proper procedure”.
strings.<strong>Zastrzeżenie co do stanu prawneg: Reservation as to the legal position. The judgment was given in 2006 against the background of the then wording of the Social Assistance Act (Article 91) and of the Act of 13 June 2003 on granting protection to foreigners within the territory of the Republic of Poland. The provisions on integration assistance for refugees were subsequently amended — the current wording of the provisions and time limits must be verified each time against the act in force. The legal principle concerning the nature of peremptory time limits nevertheless retains its general value.
strings.Jeśli zbliża się jakikolwiek termin w Tw: If any deadline in your residence or benefit case is approaching — do not delay a consultation. Assessing whether a time limit is peremptory or procedural, and whether it can still be saved, requires analysing the specific circumstances and the legal basis.

strings.Wstrzymanie pomocy cudzoziemcowi (art. 9: Suspension of assistance to a foreigner (Article 95 of the Social Assistance Act)
strings.Cudzoziemiec objęty ochroną uzupełniając: A foreigner under subsidiary protection may benefit from state-funded integration assistance. But this assistance is not unconditional — the Social Assistance Act provides for situations in which the authority must suspend or refuse it. One such ground is a final conviction for an intentional offence. Against the background of the judgment of the Provincial Administrative Court in Warsaw of 5 August 2010 (case no. V SA/Wa 934/10) we explain how Article 95 of the Social Assistance Act works, when refusal is the authority’s duty rather than its discretionary decision, and what risk is associated with a prior criminal record.
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Zarzuty skargi — jakie: Grounds of appeal — what infringements were alleged
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Wyrok WSA i jego uzasa: The court’s judgment and its reasoning
strings.Cudzoziemiec (A. B.) wraz z żoną i czwor: A foreigner (A. B.), together with his wife and four minor children, obtained subsidiary protection in the territory of Poland by a decision of the Head of the Office for Foreigners of January 2009. This entitled the family to join an Individual Integration Programme (IPI). The first programme, drawn up by the Municipal Social Assistance Centre, covered a period of 12 months (from March 2009 to February 2010); under it the family received, among other things, a maintenance benefit, funds for learning Polish and health insurance contributions.
strings.Po zmianie miejsca zamieszkania (sierpie: After changing their place of residence (August 2009), the family signed another programme — a continuation — drawn up by the District Family Assistance Centre. That programme, however, was not implemented. The starosta, acting through the Director of the District Family Assistance Centre, refused financial assistance by a decision of October 2009. The reason: the National Criminal Register showed that the foreigner had been convicted by a final judgment of the District Court (final in September 2008) of an intentional offence — illegally crossing the Polish border under Article 264 § 2 of the Criminal Code.
strings.Co to jest Indywidualny Program Integrac: What the Individual Integration Programme is.
strings.2. Zarzuty skargi — jakie naruszenia pod: 2. Grounds of appeal — what infringements were alleged
strings.Samorządowe Kolegium Odwoławcze utrzymał: The Local Government Board of Appeal upheld the refusal, pointing to the ground under Article 95(4)(2) of the Social Assistance Act (conviction by a final judgment for an intentional offence). The foreigner challenged that decision before the administrative court, alleging:
strings.naruszenie art. 95 ust. 4 pkt 2 u.p.s. p: infringement of Article 95(4)(2) of the Social Assistance Act through erroneous interpretation — in his view an offence committed before joining the programme should not cancel the right to assistance;
strings.powiązanie tej przesłanki z zakończeniem: linking that ground with the conclusion of criminal proceedings referred to in Article 95(1)(5) of the Social Assistance Act — the applicant argued that it is that provision which sets the proper basis of assessment;
strings.naruszenie art. 6 i art. 7 Kodeksu postę: infringement of Articles 6 and 7 of the Code of Administrative Procedure (the principle of legality and the principle of objective truth).
strings.Uczestnik postępowania (organizacja społ: A participant in the proceedings (a social organisation admitted to the case) additionally argued that the provisions on refusal of a benefit should relate solely to the duration of the programme (12 months), and that illegally crossing the border does not breach public order to a degree that would automatically deprive a foreigner of the chance to integrate. Reference was also made to the risk of marginalisation and exclusion of foreigners left outside the programme.
strings.3. Wyrok WSA i jego uzasadnienie: 3. The court’s judgment and its reasoning
strings.Wojewódzki Sąd Administracyjny w Warszaw: The Provincial Administrative Court in Warsaw dismissed the complaint (basis: Article 151 of the Act — Law on Proceedings before Administrative Courts). The court found the decisions of both instances correct. Key points of the reasoning:
strings.<strong>Sam fakt skazania jest wystarcza: The mere fact of conviction is a sufficient and self-standing ground for refusal. In the court’s view, it follows unequivocally from Article 95(4)(2) of the Social Assistance Act that the ground for refusal is the mere fact of the foreigner’s final conviction for an intentional offence — regardless of when it was committed. The circumstance that the act was committed before joining the programme is irrelevant to the statutory conditions.
strings.<strong>Odmowa nie jest decyzją uznaniow: Refusal is not a discretionary decision. The court stressed that once the conditions of Article 95(4) of the Social Assistance Act are met, refusal of assistance is the authority’s duty, not the result of free discretion. The authority does not weigh the circumstances here — it merely establishes whether the condition has arisen.
Distinction between paragraph 1(5) and paragraph 4(2). The court rejected the argument that the provision should be read together with Article 95(1)(5) of the Social Assistance Act. The latter concerns suspension of assistance where criminal proceedings are instituted against a foreigner while they are participating in the programme — until the case is finally concluded. That is a different factual situation from a conviction which became final before joining the programme.
strings.<strong>Art. 91 ust. 11 nie jest jedyną: Article 91(11) is not the only ground for refusal. The court did not accept that the only reason for refusal could be the condition concerning the spouse of a Polish citizen (Article 91(11) of the Social Assistance Act). The grounds for refusal are set out, among others, in Article 95(4)(1)–(3), as well as in paragraph 3 of that article.
strings.<strong>Brak wykazania naruszeń procedur: No procedural infringements demonstrated. The court found the allegation of infringement of Articles 6 and 7 of the Code of Administrative Procedure unfounded — the applicant did not show what specifically the infringements were supposed to consist in, and the court did not identify any itself.
strings.<strong>Wcześniejsza karalność ma znacze: A prior criminal record matters. A practical conclusion flows from this ruling: a final conviction for an intentional offence — including one predating entry into the integration programme — may constitute a self-standing, mandatory ground for refusing assistance. It is worth disclosing and analysing such a circumstance before filing an application.
strings.Wyrok pokazuje napięcie między dwiema li: The judgment illustrates the tension between two lines of interpretation which are worth considering in practice:
strings.<strong>Wykładnia literalna (przyjęta pr: Literal interpretation (adopted by the court). Since the provision speaks of “conviction by a final judgment for an intentionally committed offence” without setting any time frame, any such conviction — regardless of the date of the act — triggers the duty to refuse. This is the safest interpretation from the point of view of predicting the authority’s decision.
strings.<strong>Wykładnia celowościowa (podnoszo: Purposive interpretation (raised by the applicant and the social organisation). The aim of the programme is integration; the provisions on refusal should therefore be tied to the duration of the programme and to the foreigner’s conduct during it, not to acts predating the programme. This line — despite arguments about the risk of exclusion — was not accepted in this case.
strings.<strong>Ścieżki działania, które warto r: Courses of action worth considering in a similar situation:
strings.weryfikacja statusu skazania — czy wyrok: verifying the status of the conviction — whether the judgment is final and whether the conviction has been expunged (expungement removes the effect of being a “convicted person”, which may matter for the assessment of the condition);
strings.ustalenie, czy czyn faktycznie jest prze: establishing whether the act is indeed an intentional offence and whether its classification in the National Criminal Register is correct;
strings.rozważenie środków w postępowaniu karnym: considering measures in the criminal proceedings (e.g. reopening, pardon) where there are grounds for them — as a route indirectly affecting the assistance condition;
strings.analiza innych, niezależnych od IPI form: analysing other forms of social support, independent of the integration programme, to which the foreigner may be entitled.
strings.<strong>Ocena ryzyka.</strong> Ryzyko od: Risk assessment. The risk of refusal in an analogous case is high: where there is a final conviction for an intentional offence the authority acts under a bound competence, and the administrative court examines mainly whether the condition has arisen. Effectively challenging the decision usually requires undermining the condition itself (e.g. lack of finality, expungement of the conviction, incorrect classification), rather than relying solely on purposive arguments. Every such case should be assessed individually with a lawyer before filing an application or an appeal.
strings.<strong>Uwaga o aktualności stanu prawne: Note on the currency of the legal position. The judgment discussed dates from 2010 and refers to the wording of the Social Assistance Act in force at that time. The numbering and content of the provisions on assistance for foreigners (including Articles 91–95) may have changed since then. Before taking any action, the current text of the Act should be verified.

strings.1. Kogo i jakich dokumentów dotyczy term: 1. Who and which documents are covered by the 3 August 2026 deadline
strings.Termin wynika z <strong>przepisów przejś: The deadline follows from the transitional provisions of the Act of 10 December 2020 amending the Act on the entry into, stay in and exit from the territory of the Republic of Poland of citizens of European Union Member States and members of their families and certain other acts (Journal of Laws of 2020, item 2369). That Act changed the document templates in force from 2 August 2021, and documents issued under the earlier templates remained valid only transitionally — until 3 August 2026 at the latest.
strings.Zgodnie z komunikatem UDSC termin dotycz: According to the Office for Foreigners' announcement, the deadline concerns documents issued up to 1 August 2021 (i.e. under the templates in force before 2 August 2021), namely:
strings.zaświadczenia o zarejestrowaniu pobytu o: the certificate of registration of residence of an EU citizen (paper document),
strings.dokumentu potwierdzającego prawo stałego: the document confirming the right of permanent residence of an EU citizen,
strings.karty pobytu członka rodziny obywatela U: the residence card of a family member of an EU citizen,
strings.karty stałego pobytu członka rodziny oby: the permanent residence card of a family member of an EU citizen.
strings.<strong>Jak sprawdzić, czy Cię to dotycz: How to check whether this concerns you? Look at the date the document was issued. If it was issued up to 1 August 2021 and falls into one of the categories above, it will expire after 3 August 2026. Documents issued from 2 August 2021 (the new templates) are not affected by this deadline.
strings.2. Co zrobić — wniosek o nowy dokument d: 2. What to do — application for a new document to the voivode
strings.UDSC zachęca, aby przed upływem terminu: The Office for Foreigners encourages you to file, before the deadline expires, the appropriate application for a new document with the voivode competent for your place of residence. In practice you have several options to consider:
strings.<strong>Wariant A — wymiana z wyprzedzen: Option A — early replacement (recommended). Filing the application before 3 August 2026 lets you avoid a period in which you are left without a valid document confirming your status. This is the safest solution, especially if you need the document in everyday life (work, bank, inspections, travel).
Option B — application after the deadline. Also after 3 August 2026, EU citizens and their family members will be able to apply for a new certificate of registration of residence, a new document confirming the right of permanent residence, a new residence card or a new permanent residence card — in connection with the expiry of the documents they hold. That does not mean, however, that it is worth delaying (see section 4).
strings.<strong>Co ważne — nie zaczynasz procedu: Importantly — you do not start the procedure over. EU citizens do not have to apply again for registration of residence or for a document confirming the right of permanent residence, and their family members do not have to apply again for a residence card or a permanent residence card. It is only about issuing a new document confirming a right that already exists.
strings.<strong>Właściwy organ:</strong> wojewod: Competent authority: the voivode competent for the place of residence (for EU citizens and their family members, residence matters are handled by the voivodeship office, not by the Office for Foreigners itself). It is worth confirming the required attachments and the form directly with the competent voivodeship office.
strings.3. Utrata ważności dokumentu ≠ utrata pr: 3. Expiry of the document ≠ loss of the right of residence
strings.To kluczowa informacja z komunikatu UDSC: This is the key point of the Office for Foreigners' announcement: the expiry of the above documents does not mean the loss of the right of residence or the right of permanent residence in the territory of the Republic of Poland. As long as an EU citizen meets the conditions for the right of residence in Poland, they hold that right, and their family member may enjoy a derived right of residence. The right of permanent residence likewise does not lapse because the document confirming it has expired.
strings.Wynika to z <strong>deklaratoryjnego cha: This results from the declaratory nature of these documents: they confirm the right of residence but do not create it. The right of residence of an EU citizen and their family stems from European Union law and national provisions, not from holding a card or certificate. The document is evidence of status — its absence or expiry does not take the status itself away.
strings.<strong>Termin: 3 sierpnia 2026 r.</stro: Deadline: 3 August 2026. Although the right of residence is not lost, after that date the old document will no longer be valid proof of status. In everyday situations (an inspection, an employer, a bank, crossing the border) the lack of a current document can genuinely make life harder — which is why the Office for Foreigners encourages filing the application before the deadline.
Low risk — residence status. The mere expiry of the document does not cause the loss of the right of residence or of permanent residence; it does not entail "loss of legality" within the meaning of the provisions on third-country nationals (EU citizens and their families are subject to a separate regime).
Practical risk — moderate. Without a valid document you may have difficulty proving your status to an employer, a bank, ZUS, when claiming benefits or while travelling and during inspections. The risk grows with the number of situations in which the document is required.
strings.<strong>Rekomendacja.</strong> Jeżeli po: Recommendation. If you hold one of the old documents (issued up to 1 August 2021), the safest course is to file an application for a new document with the competent voivode in advance, before 3 August 2026. Before filing, it is worth confirming the current form and the list of attachments with the voivodeship office; if you have doubts about your own situation (e.g. loss of the original basis of residence, change of family status), legal advice is advisable.

strings.Zasiłek pielęgnacyjny 215,84 zł przy cuk: Care allowance of PLN 215.84 for diabetes — will a foreigner receive it?
strings.W lipcu 2026 r. media znów przypomniały,: In July 2026 the media once again recalled that people suffering from diabetes may receive a care allowance of PLN 215.84 per month — regardless of income. Such publications, however, are addressed to Polish citizens and seniors. A foreigner is interested in a different, key question: with my residence title, am I entitled to this benefit at all? Below we explain the legal basis, indicate which groups of foreigners are entitled and which are excluded, and assess the risks.
strings.<a href=\"#sek1\">Czym jest zasiłek piel: What the care allowance is and how much it amounts to
strings.<a href=\"#sek2\">Czy cudzoziemiec z cuk: Is a foreigner with diabetes entitled to the allowance
strings.<a href=\"#sek3\">Cukrzyca a orzeczenie: Diabetes and a disability certificate — how to document it
strings.1. Czym jest zasiłek pielęgnacyjny i ile: 1. What the care allowance is and how much it amounts to
strings.Zasiłek pielęgnacyjny to świadczenie opi: The care allowance is a care benefit governed by Article 16 of the Act of 28 November 2003 on family benefits (consolidated text: Journal of Laws 2025, item 1208). It is granted to cover in part the costs arising from the need to ensure care and assistance from another person in connection with an inability to live independently. The amount is currently PLN 215.84 per month and is not subject to annual indexation — the next review of family benefit amounts is due in 2027.
strings.Zgodnie z art. 16 ustawy świadczenie prz: Under Article 16 of the Act, the benefit is due primarily to: a disabled child; a person over 16 with a certificate of a severe degree of disability; a person over 16 with a moderate degree of disability, if the disability arose before the age of 21; and also a person who has reached the age of 75 (by operation of law). Diabetes is not listed in the Act as a self-standing ground — what counts is the certified degree of disability and the resulting limitations.
strings.2. Czy cudzoziemiec z cukrzycą ma prawo: 2. Is a foreigner with diabetes entitled to the allowance
strings.Zasiłek pielęgnacyjny należy do świadcze: The care allowance belongs to family benefits, so the circle of entitled foreigners is defined by Article 1(2) and (3) of the Family Benefits Act. This is the most important difference from articles written “for Poles”: not every foreigner residing legally in Poland is entitled. The Act lists, among others:
strings.cudzoziemców, do których stosuje się prz: foreigners to whom the provisions on the coordination of social security systems apply, or where this follows from bilateral social security agreements,
strings.posiadaczy zezwolenia na pobyt stały ora: holders of a permanent residence permit and of an EU long-term resident’s permit,
strings.posiadaczy karty pobytu z adnotacją „dos: holders of a residence card annotated “access to the labour market” — with important exclusions (including work for a period not exceeding 6 months, admission for the purpose of studies or seasonal work, work on the basis of a visa),

strings.Podstawą zasiłku nie jest sama diagnoza: The basis for the allowance is not the diagnosis of diabetes itself, but a certificate of disability or of the degree of disability. It is issued by the District (Municipal) Disability Assessment Board. Only once you have the certificate do you apply for the benefit itself to the municipal authority (social assistance centre / benefits centre), also electronically via the mObywatel app or the Emp@tia portal.
strings.W praktyce orzeczniczej samo dobre wyrów: In assessment practice, a well-controlled glycated haemoglobin result (HbA1c) alone is sometimes read to the applicant’s disadvantage. That is why — as patient guides point out — it is worth presenting not only a medical certificate but also a realistic picture of the illness: printouts from continuous glucose monitoring systems (e.g. LibreView, Dexcom Clarity), episodes of nocturnal hypoglycaemia and blood-sugar fluctuations, and a description of limitations in everyday functioning. This is a matter of practice, not a statutory condition — the assessment rests with the adjudicating panel.
What else a disability certificate gives you.
strings.Nawet przy spełnieniu warunku pobytowego: Even where the residence condition is met and a certificate has been obtained, the statutory exclusions must be borne in mind. The care allowance is not payable to a person placed in an institution providing round-the-clock maintenance. Nor can it be combined with the care supplement paid by ZUS (this most often concerns pensioners and persons receiving a disability pension) — if the ZUS supplement is due, the municipal allowance will not be granted. The ZUS care supplement is usually higher, so for most entitled persons it is the more advantageous solution; choosing between them requires comparing the specific amounts in a given case.
strings.<strong>Ocena ryzyka.</strong> Dla cudzo: Risk assessment. For a foreigner the most frequent risks are: (1) refusal because of a residence title outside the catalogue in Article 1(2) — a real risk, especially with short residence and work permits and work on the basis of a visa; (2) a negative decision of the assessment board where the documentation does not reflect the actual limitations — a risk reduced by thorough medical documentation; (3) conflict with the ZUS care supplement. A refusal by the municipal authority may be appealed to the local government board of appeal (14 days), and a disability certificate may be appealed to the provincial board. Before filing an application it is worth verifying your own residence title and assembling the documentation so as not to “burn” the case on a formal error.

strings.Ostatnia aktualizacja: 7 lipca 2026 · Au: Last updated: 7 July 2026 · Author: Kancelaria TRC team · Reading time: approx. 5 min
strings.Przez lata symbolem „oczekiwania na kart: For years the symbol of "waiting for a residence card" was the red stamp in the passport. With the switch to electronic applications through MOS the stamp is becoming history — its role is taken over by the certificate of application submission issued in electronic form. We explain what it gives you in practice.
strings.Po skutecznym złożeniu wniosku w MOS otr: After successfully submitting the application in MOS you first receive the UPO (official confirmation of receipt) — proof that the application was filed on a specific date. If the application was filed on time and has no formal defects (or the defects were remedied on time), the authority issues a certificate confirming that your stay is legal while the proceedings are pending — until the day the decision becomes final.
strings.<strong>UPO ≠ zaświadczenie.</strong> UP: UPO ≠ certificate. The UPO only confirms the date the application was received. The certificate confirms that your stay is legal while the case is pending. Keep both documents.
strings.2. Co daje zaświadczenie — a czego nie d: 2. What the certificate gives you — and what it does not
strings.Czy legalizuje pobyt w Polsce?: Does it make my stay in Poland legal?
strings.<strong>Tak</strong> — jeśli wniosek zło: Yes — if the application was filed on time and without defects, the stay is legal until the proceedings end.
strings.Czy pozwala pracować?: Does it allow me to work?
strings.<strong>To zależy.</strong> Samo zaświad: It depends. The certificate alone does not grant the right to work. Work during the proceedings is legal only if you have a separate basis (e.g. an existing work permit, a declaration, an exemption from the permit requirement) or a specific provision allows it.
strings.Czy pozwala podróżować po strefie Scheng: Does it allow me to travel within the Schengen area?
strings.<strong>Nie.</strong> Zaświadczenie dzia: No. The certificate is valid in Poland only.
strings.Czy pozwala wrócić do Polski po wyjeździ: Does it allow me to return to Poland after leaving?
strings.<strong>Nie.</strong> Wyjazd w toku post: No. Leaving while the proceedings are pending without a valid visa or another basis for return means a risk of being refused entry. If you have to travel — consult it beforehand.
strings.Czy zastępuje kartę pobytu?: Does it replace the residence card?
strings.<strong>Nie.</strong> To dokument tymcza: No. It is a temporary document for the duration of the proceedings.
strings.3. Jak okazać zaświadczenie pracodawcy l: 3. How to present the certificate to an employer or during an inspection
strings.Zaświadczenie ma postać elektroniczną —: The certificate is in electronic form — you can keep it on your phone and print it out. The employer should attach it to the documentation proving the legality of employment (together with the document confirming the right to work). During a Border Guard inspection you present your passport and the certificate.
strings.4. Co jeśli urząd nie wydał zaświadczeni: 4. What if the authority has not issued the certificate?
strings.Sprawdź w MOS, czy wniosek nie ma braków: Check in MOS whether the application has formal defects — this is the most common reason.
strings.Zweryfikuj, czy wniosek złożono podczas: Verify that the application was filed during a legal stay — after the deadline the certificate is not granted.
strings.Jeśli formalnie wszystko się zgadza, złó: If everything is formally in order, file a request for the certificate through MOS or in writing; if the authority fails to act, you may lodge a ponaglenie (a formal reminder urging the authority to act).

strings.Zmiana pracy z kartą pobytu to nie tylko: Changing jobs while holding a residence card is not just a new contract — it also means obligations towards the authority and deadlines that start running from day one. What costs most here is not the change of employer itself, but the mistaken belief that "the authority will sort everything out". Check what to do so that a new job does not take away your legal stay.

strings.1. Czy możesz po prostu zacząć pracę u n: 1. Can you simply start working for a new employer?
It depends on the type of your permit. With full access to the labour market there is more freedom. But if you hold a temporary residence and work permit "tied" to a specific employer, position and conditions, you cannot simply take up work elsewhere on that basis — an application to change the permit is usually required.
strings.<strong>Najpierw sprawdź swoją decyzję.<: Check your decision first. What is allowed under one type of permit may be a breach of the conditions of stay under another.
strings.2. Jak działa termin 15 dni po utracie p: 2. How does the 15-day deadline after losing your job work?
strings.Przepisy przewidują obowiązek zawiadomie: The regulations provide for an obligation to notify the voivode within 15 working days about the loss of work with the employer named in the permit; the obligation is also deemed fulfilled if within that time you file an application to change the permit (Act on Foreigners; verify the detailed numbering of the provision against the current text). The clock runs regardless of whether you have a complete set of documents from your former company.
strings.<strong>Ryzyko:</strong> brak zawiadomie: Risk: failure to notify on time may become grounds for withdrawing the permit. Do not put it off "until after the holidays".
strings.3. Co grozi, jeśli nic nie zrobisz?: 3. What happens if you do nothing?
strings.Utrata kontroli nad legalnością pracy i: Loss of control over the legality of your work and stay. At first everything looks fine, but after a few weeks it turns out that the formalities were not completed — and then problems tend to pile up: work inconsistent with the permit, no response to letters and, in extreme cases, withdrawal of the permit.
strings.ustal dokładnie, jaki rodzaj zezwolenia: establish exactly what type of permit you hold and what follows from it,

strings.Podstawy prawne samej procedury zmiany o: We also describe the legal basis of the change procedure itself in the article changing employer and the residence card — the procedure.
strings.Czy muszę zgłaszać utratę pracy, jeśli o: Do I have to report the loss of my job if I already have a new one?
strings.Tak — obowiązek zawiadomienia wojewody d: Yes — the obligation to notify the voivode concerns the loss of work with the employer named in the permit. It is also deemed fulfilled if within 15 working days you file an application to change the permit.
strings.Czy w trakcie zmiany zezwolenia mogę pra: Can I work for the new employer while the permit is being changed?
strings.To zależy od Twojej indywidualnej sytuac: It depends on your individual situation and the type of permit — do not assume in advance that you can. Starting work in breach of the conditions of the permit is one of the most common and most costly missteps.

strings.Karta pobytu i legalizacja pobytu w Pols: Residence card and legalisation of stay in Poland — FAQ
strings.Jak uzyskać kartę pobytu, jakie dokument: How to obtain a residence card, what documents to prepare, how long it takes and how much it costs — short, concrete answers about legalisation of stay and work of foreigners in 2026. Residence card in Poland · Tarjeta de residencia en Polonia.
strings.FAQ — karta pobytu i legalizacja pobytu: FAQ — residence card and legalisation of stay in Poland (2026)
strings.Pomoc w legalizacji pobytu i pracy cudzo: Help with legalisation of stay and work of foreigners — everything in one place: residence card application, documents, fees, deadlines, temporary and permanent residence, work permit.
strings.Co to jest karta pobytu i co daje?: What is a residence card and what does it give you?
strings.Karta pobytu to dokument pobytowy potwie: A residence card is a residence document confirming a foreigner's identity and their right to stay legally in Poland. It is issued after obtaining a temporary residence permit, permanent residence permit or EU long-term resident permit. A residence card in Poland entitles you, among other things, to cross the border multiple times without a visa and to travel within the Schengen area (up to 90 days within any 180-day period), and — together with the appropriate permit — to work legally. What a residence card gives you therefore depends on the type of permit on the basis of which it was issued.
strings.Jak uzyskać kartę pobytu w Polsce?: How to obtain a residence card in Poland?
strings.Legalizacja pobytu w Polsce przebiega w: Legalisation of stay in Poland takes place in several steps: choosing the right type of permit (temporary residence, permanent residence, EU long-term resident), gathering the documents, submitting the application electronically via the MOS system, giving fingerprints at the voivodeship office, and — after a positive decision — collecting the residence card. We help with legalisation of stay at every stage — from case assessment to card collection.
strings.Czy karta pobytu uprawnia do pracy?: Does a residence card entitle you to work?
strings.Nie zawsze. Sama karta pobytu potwierdza: Not always. The residence card itself confirms legal stay — the right to work depends on the type of permit. A temporary residence and work permit (the so-called single permit) legalises both stay and work for the indicated employer. A card with the annotation "access to the labour market" allows you to work without a separate work permit. Before taking up employment, it is always worth checking the scope of your permit.
strings.Jakie dokumenty do karty pobytu są potrz: What documents are needed for a residence card?
strings.Podstawowe dokumenty do karty pobytu to:: The basic documents for a residence card are: a valid passport, a photograph, proof of payment of the stamp duty and documents confirming the purpose of stay — for temporary residence and work, among others, Annex no. 1 from the employer, a contract, health insurance and a place of residence. The list of documents for temporary residence differs depending on the purpose (work, studies, family, business). We prepare an individual list of documents for each case.
strings.Ile kosztuje karta pobytu? Jaka jest opł: How much does a residence card cost? What is the fee?
strings.Opłata za kartę pobytu składa się z kilk: The residence card fee consists of several parts: the stamp duty for the permit (for temporary residence and work — PLN 440, for permanent residence and EU resident — PLN 640), the fee for amending a temporary residence and work permit, e.g. when changing employer (PLN 220), and the fee for issuing the card itself (PLN 100). Rates may change — we confirm the current amounts before submitting the application. With a positive decision, the stamp duty is non-refundable; in case of refusal, you may apply for a refund.
strings.Czy mogę dostać zwrot opłaty skarbowej i: Can I get a refund of the stamp duty and when?
strings.Tak — opłata skarbowa podlega zwrotowi,: Yes — the stamp duty is refundable if, despite its payment, the permit was not issued (Stamp Duty Act). The refund is due, among others, when: you received a refusal decision, the application was left without examination (e.g. due to formal deficiencies), the proceedings were discontinued, you withdrew the application before a decision was issued, and also when, after the case was transferred to another voivodeship office, the fee was paid again — then the first payment can be recovered. The refund is made only upon a request submitted to the competent city/municipality office (tax authority), and the right to a refund expires 5 years from the end of the year in which the payment was made. The fee for issuing the residence card (PLN 100) is refundable if the card was not issued. Note: with a positive decision no refund is due. We prepare stamp duty refund applications for our clients.
strings.Jak złożyć wniosek o kartę pobytu?: How to submit a residence card application?
strings.Od 27 kwietnia 2026 r. wniosek o pobyt c: From 27 April 2026, applications for temporary residence, permanent residence and EU long-term resident status are submitted exclusively electronically via the MOS system (Case Handling Module). After sending the application, you will receive a summons to appear in person at the voivodeship office to give fingerprints. We submit applications together with our clients — without errors or formal deficiencies.
strings.Czy mogę jeszcze złożyć papierowy wniose: Can I still file a paper residence-card application?
strings.Nie. Od 27 kwietnia 2026 r. wnioski o ze: No. From 27 April 2026, applications for temporary residence, permanent residence and EU long-term resident status are filed exclusively online via the MOS system. A paper application will be left unexamined. There are exceptions (e.g. certain family matters and ICT) — we'll check whether they apply to your situation.
strings.Nie znam polskiego. Jak wypełnię wniosek: I don't speak Polish. How do I complete the MOS application?
strings.Formularz MOS dostępny jest wyłącznie po: The MOS form is available in Polish only. That's exactly why we offer the "Error-free application" package — we complete and file the application together with you, speaking in your language (English, Spanish, Portuguese).
strings.Co oznacza stempel w paszporcie przy kar: What does the stamp in the passport mean for a residence card?
strings.Stempel w paszporcie (obecnie także potw: The stamp in the passport (now also an electronic confirmation in the MOS system) is proof that the residence card application was submitted on time and without formal deficiencies. It legalises your stay in Poland until the day the decision becomes final. Note: the stamp does not entitle you to travel within the Schengen area or — as a rule — to return to Poland without a visa.
strings.Czy mogę legalnie przebywać w Polsce w t: Can I stay in Poland legally while my application is being processed?
strings.Co do zasady tak — po skutecznym złożeni: As a rule, yes — once the application is effectively filed, you receive a certificate that legalises your stay until the decision. The condition is filing on time, during a legal stay. Every situation requires individual assessment.
strings.Ile się czeka na kartę pobytu?: How long do you wait for a residence card?
strings.Czas oczekiwania na kartę pobytu różni s: The waiting time for a residence card varies depending on the voivodeship office and the type of case — from several months upwards. The statutory deadline for issuing a decision is often exceeded in practice. A correctly submitted application without formal deficiencies is the most effective way to shorten the wait; in case of excessive length of proceedings, you can file a reminder (ponaglenie).
strings.Jak sprawdzić status sprawy o kartę poby: How to check the status of a residence card case?
strings.Sprawdzenie statusu sprawy o kartę pobyt: Checking the status of a residence card case is possible in the MOS system and on the information portals of some voivodeship offices (by case number). If the case is handled by a representative, they receive the correspondence — but you always have the right to know the stage of your own proceedings. We monitor our clients' cases on an ongoing basis.
strings.Co jeśli brakuje mi dokumentów do karty: What if I am missing documents for the residence card?
strings.Brak dokumentów do karty pobytu nie zaws: Missing documents for a residence card do not always ruin the case. Formal deficiencies can be completed within the deadline set by the office (usually 7–14 days from the summons). Some documents can be recreated or replaced with other evidence. The most dangerous thing is to ignore the summons — the application will then be left without examination. We will assess free of charge what is missing and how to complete it.
strings.Co zrobić, gdy nie dostałem wezwania z u: What to do when I have not received a letter from the office?
strings.Wezwanie z urzędu (np. do uzupełnienia b: A summons from the office (e.g. to complete formal deficiencies of the application) goes to the representative — if the case is handled by an employer or agency, correspondence goes to them, and the deadline runs regardless of whether it was passed on to you. Uncompleted formal deficiencies mean the application is left without examination, which can even lead to the loss of legal stay. If you suspect you have missed a summons — act immediately: establish who the representative in the case is, ask for the correspondence, and if necessary revoke the power of attorney. We will analyse the documents you have free of charge and advise on the next steps.
strings.Legalizacja pracy — praca cudzoziemca w: Legalisation of work — a foreigner's work in Poland
strings.Czym jest zezwolenie na pracę i kto go p: What is a work permit and who needs it?
strings.Zezwolenie na pracę to dokument legalizu: A work permit is a document legalising a foreigner's work in Poland — it is obtained by the employer for a specific position and terms of employment. Legal work of foreigners requires both legal stay (visa, residence card, visa-free travel) and a work entitlement (work permit, declaration on entrusting work, or single permit). We help with legalisation of work for both foreigners and employers.
strings.Kiedy można pracować bez zezwolenia na p: When can you work without a work permit?
Those who can work without a work permit include: holders of a permanent residence permit and an EU long-term resident permit, spouses of Polish citizens with the appropriate residence permit, full-time students and graduates of full-time programmes at Polish universities, persons with international protection, and holders of a residence card with the annotation "access to the labour market". The catalogue of exemptions is broad — we will check whether it covers your situation.
strings.Co daje zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy i pr: What does a temporary residence and work permit (single permit) give you?
strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy i pracę to n: A temporary residence and work permit is the most popular form of legalising stay and work in Poland in a single procedure — with one application you legalise your stay and employment with the indicated employer. It is issued for a maximum of 3 years. Changing employer or working conditions requires, as a rule, an amendment of the permit or a new application.
strings.Straciłem pracę — co z moją kartą pobytu: I lost my job — what about my residence card?
strings.Brak pracy nie odbiera karty pobytu auto: Losing your job does not automatically take away your residence card, but it triggers short deadlines: you must notify the voivode of the loss of work, as a rule, within 15 working days. After the notification, you have time to find a new employer and amend the permit. Ignoring this obligation may end in the withdrawal of the permit. Contact us immediately after losing your job — we will help you keep your legal stay.
strings.Pobyt stały i rezydent długoterminowy UE: Permanent residence and EU long-term resident
strings.Kiedy mogę uzyskać zezwolenie na pobyt s: When can I obtain a permanent residence permit?
strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt stały wydawane jest: A permanent residence permit is issued for an indefinite period, among others, to persons of Polish origin, holders of the Pole's Card intending to settle in Poland, spouses of Polish citizens (after 3 years of marriage and the required period of stay), and in other cases specified in the act. The permanent residence application is submitted via the MOS system. The residence card is replaced every 10 years — the permit itself does not expire.
strings.Czym jest pobyt rezydenta długoterminowe: What is EU long-term resident status?
strings.Pobyt rezydenta długoterminowego UE to z: The EU long-term resident permit is an indefinite permit for foreigners who have stayed in Poland legally and continuously for at least 5 years, have a stable source of income, health insurance and confirmed knowledge of Polish (at least B1). It gives full access to the labour market and makes it easier to settle in other EU countries. The card is replaced every 5 years.
strings.Kiedy konieczna jest wymiana karty pobyt: When is a residence card replacement necessary?
A residence card replacement is required, among others, when the data on the card changes (surname, citizenship), when your appearance changes in a way that hinders identification, in case of damage or loss of the card, and after the expiry of its validity for indefinite permits (permanent residence — every 10 years, EU resident — every 5 years). The replacement application is submitted to the voivode; the fee for issuing a new card is PLN 100 (a duplicate after loss through the holder's fault may cost more).
strings.Jak przedłużyć kartę pobytu?: How to extend a residence card?
strings.Karty pobytu czasowego nie przedłuża się: A temporary residence card is not extended — before the permit expires, you must submit a new temporary residence application (via MOS), at the latest on the last day of legal stay. Submitting the application on time legalises your stay for the duration of the procedure. Do not wait until the last moment: gathering the documents takes time, and a late application means illegal stay.
strings.Odmowa — jak wygląda odwołanie od decyzj: Refusal — what does an appeal against a residence card decision look like?
strings.Od decyzji odmownej wojewody przysługuje: An appeal against a refusal decision of the voivode lies to the Head of the Office for Foreigners within 14 days of delivery of the decision. After a negative second-instance decision, you can file a complaint with the voivodeship administrative court (30 days). An appeal against a residence card decision should be based on specific objections — we analyse refusal decisions and handle appeal cases.
strings.Na czym polega zasada „skuteczna pomoc a: What does “effective help or a refund” mean?
strings.W pakietach z reprezentacją zobowiązujem: In packages with representation we undertake to refund our fee if you do not obtain a residence card. The detailed terms, including exclusions (e.g. providing false information), are set out in the Terms and Conditions available on the website.
strings.Pracodawca lub agencja złożyła mój wnios: My employer or agency submitted my residence card application and won't give me the documents. What should I do?
strings.To nadal Twoja sprawa — nawet jeśli wnio: It is still your case — even if someone else submitted the application. You have the right to know the stage of the proceedings and to receive copies of the documents, and you can revoke the power of attorney at any time and take over the case or hand it to an independent representative. Important when changing jobs: without promptly notifying the office, the application may be discontinued or left without examination. See the comparison and your rights →
strings.Kto powinien prowadzić sprawę o kartę po: Who should handle a residence card case — the employer or an independent lawyer?
strings.Wniosek o pobyt czasowy i pracę może prz: An application for temporary residence and work may be prepared by a representative — this can be the employer, an agency or an independent lawyer for the foreigner. The difference is fundamental: an independent representative acts solely in your interest, and all residence card documents and access to the case remain with you — also when changing jobs. See the full comparison →
strings.Czy pracodawca może prowadzić wniosek o: Can an employer handle a residence card application for a foreigner?
strings.Tak — prawo na to pozwala, jeśli udzieli: Yes — the law allows it, if you grant a power of attorney. Remember, however, that it is still your case: legalisation of a foreigner's stay is the obligation and right of the foreigner themselves. When changing employer, short deadlines apply (as a rule, 15 working days to notify the voivode of the loss of work and 30 days to update the case) — if only the company has the documents, it is easy to miss them. Check your rights →

strings.W polskich miastach jeździsz autobusem,: In Polish cities you travel by bus and tram, and in Warsaw also by metro and fast urban rail. You buy a ticket before or when boarding and — if it is a paper/single ticket — you validate it immediately in the vehicle.
strings.Najczęstsze rodzaje biletów: <b>jednoraz: The most common ticket types: single (one journey), time-based (e.g. 20/60/90 minutes, with transfers) and period (daily, weekly, monthly — worthwhile for commuting to work). strings.Najprościej mieć bilet w telefonie. Do <: The easiest way is to have your ticket on your phone. jakdojade is used for route planning and buying tickets in dozens of cities. You can also buy tickets in apps such as moBiLET, mPay, SkyCash, zBiletem — paying by card or BLIK.
strings.Schemat jest zawsze podobny: pobierz apl: The pattern is always similar: download the app → register → link a card or top up the wallet → choose the city, line and ticket type → buy and (if required) activate the ticket when boarding the vehicle.
strings.<b>Uwaga na kontrolę.</b> Jazda bez ważn: Watch out for inspections. Travelling without a valid (validated/activated) ticket risks a fine. An app ticket also has to be activated — purchase alone is not enough. You need internet on your phone to buy a ticket online.
strings.Coraz rzadziej. Najpewniej kup bilet w a: Less and less often. The safest way is to buy a ticket in an app, from a ticket machine (often in the vehicle or at the stop) or at a kiosk. In many cities, machines in vehicles accept contactless cards.

strings.Jeżeli mieszkasz w Polsce dłużej niż 30: If you live in Poland for longer than 30 days, you can register your address — a PESEL is then assigned automatically. strings.Gdy pracujesz legalnie na umowie, pracod: When you work legally under a contract, your employer registers you with ZUS and you use public healthcare financed by the NFZ. strings.1. Pobyt czasowy w Polsce — jak uporządk: 1. Temporary residence in Poland — how to put your legal stay in order
strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy to podstawow: A temporary residence permit is the basic way of legalising a foreigner's stay in Poland — granted for up to 3 years and confirmed with a residence card. The most common problems are: filing too late, choosing the wrong basis of stay and incomplete residence card documents.
strings.Kiedy złożyć wniosek o pobyt czasowy?: When to file a temporary residence application?
strings.Wniosek trzeba złożyć najpóźniej ostatni: The application must be filed no later than the last day of your legal stay (visa, visa-free travel or your current card). Filing on time and without formal gaps gives you legal stay for the whole proceedings. From 27 April 2026 applications are filed exclusively electronically in the MOS system — paper applications are left without examination.
strings.Pierwszy wniosek czy kolejny — czym się: First application or the next one — what is the difference?
strings.Karty pobytu czasowego nie przedłuża się: A temporary residence card is not extended — before it expires you file a new, complete application. With the next application the office re-examines your whole situation: work, income, insurance, place of residence. We help you file the first application, the next one and put your legal stay in order when there have been gaps.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> dobieramy: How we help: we choose the right basis of stay, complete the documents, file the application in MOS and watch over the case until you collect the residence card. Details: Temporary residence card — everything you need to know.
strings.2. Legalna praca i pobyt — jakie dokumen: 2. Legal work and residence — which documents you need
strings.Legalna praca cudzoziemca w Polsce wymag: Legal work of a foreigner in Poland requires two things at once: legal residence and a document entitling you to work. We check whether you can work legally and which documents you need in your situation.
strings.Jakie dokumenty pozwalają pracować legal: Which documents allow you to work legally in Poland?

strings.To zależy od Twojej sytuacji: znaczenie: It depends on your situation: what matters is, among other things, whether your previous document allowed work for this employer and whether the application was filed on time. Work without the required document is illegal employment — a risk of penalties and problems with the next legalisation. Before you start work, check your situation — we will assess your documents free of charge.

strings.3. Brak decyzji i długi czas oczekiwania: 3. No decision and long waiting time for a residence card — what to do
strings.Długi czas oczekiwania na kartę pobytu t: Long waiting time for a residence card is one of the most common problems of foreigners in Poland. Months without a reply, no letter from the office, a helpline that doesn't work — but the office's inaction is not a dead end.
strings.Co zrobić, gdy urząd nie wydaje decyzji?: What to do when the office does not issue a decision?
strings.<strong>Ponaglenie</strong> — pismo do o: Reminder (ponaglenie) — a letter to the higher authority when the case takes longer than the law provides. The office must respond to it.
strings.<strong>Skarga na bezczynność lub przewl: Complaint about inaction or excessive length to the voivodeship administrative court — when the reminder doesn't work; the court can order the office to issue a decision.
strings.Brak wezwania nie zawsze oznacza, że spr: No letter does not always mean the case is going well — it may have gone to a wrong address or to a representative you don't control (e.g. appointed by an agency). We check the case files, establish what stage the proceedings are at and take over correspondence with the office. More: No letter from the office — what to do.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> piszemy p: How we help: we write the reminder, prepare the complaint about inaction and act when the case takes too long and the office does nothing.
strings.4. Błędy i braki formalne we wniosku o k: 4. Errors and formal gaps in the residence card application — how to fix them
strings.Braki formalne wniosku to najczęstszy po: Formal gaps in the application are the most common reason a residence card case ends before it began. No signature, no photos, unpaid stamp duty, missing attachments — the office calls for completion, and if you don't make it, it leaves the application without examination.
strings.Co oznacza pozostawienie wniosku bez roz: What does leaving the application without examination mean?
strings.Urząd traktuje sprawę tak, jakby wniosek: The office treats the case as if the application had never arrived. You lose the legal stay resulting from filing — and often also the deadline in which you could have filed. That is why you must reply to the call to complete the gaps within the set deadline, completely and with proof of submission.
strings.Jakie błędy we wniosku zdarzają się najc: Which application errors happen most often?
strings.zła podstawa pobytu lub niewłaściwy typ: wrong basis of stay or wrong type of application,

strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> uzupełnia: How we help: we complete the documents, correct the application and prepare the case for filing — and when the call has already arrived, we reply to it on time.
strings.5. Zmiana pracodawcy lub warunków pracy: 5. Change of employer or working conditions — what to report so you do not lose your residence card
strings.Karta pobytu a zmiana pracodawcy to tema: A residence card and a change of employer is the topic where foreigners lose the legality of their stay most often. The single permit names a specific employer and working conditions — a new job, a different position or reduced hours usually require a reaction.
strings.Straciłem pracę — ile mam czasu?: I lost my job — how much time do I have?
strings.Utratę pracy trzeba zgłosić wojewodzie p: You must report the loss of your job to the voivode in writing within 15 working days. Reporting on time protects you from withdrawal of the permit and gives you time to find a new employer and file a new application.
strings.Zmieniam pracodawcę — co dalej?: I am changing employer — what next?
strings.Co do zasady potrzebna jest zmiana zezwo: As a rule you need a change of the permit or a new application — a new contract alone is not enough. We explain what must be reported and how not to lose the legality of your stay and work: Change of employer and the residence card.
strings.Kto powinien prowadzić sprawę o kartę po: Who should handle your residence card case — your employer or a lawyer?
strings.Jeśli kartę robił za Ciebie pracodawca l: If your card was handled by your employer or an agency, the case may be run in their interest, not yours — and when you change jobs you lose control of your own stay. Check your rights: Residence card — lawyer or employer?
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> zgłaszamy: How we help: we report the loss of work on time, prepare a new application or a change of the permit and take the case over from the employer or agency.

strings.6. Odmowa, cofnięcie zezwolenia, pobyt n: 6. Refusal, withdrawal of the permit, illegal stay — appeal against the decision
strings.Odmowa wydania karty pobytu, cofnięcie z: Refusal of a residence card, withdrawal of a permit or a stay that has become illegal — these are the hardest, yet still solvable, legalisation problems. Many negative decisions are issued for formal reasons that can be challenged.
strings.Dostałem decyzję odmowną — ile mam czasu: I received a negative decision — how much time do I have to appeal?
strings.Odwołanie od decyzji wojewody składa się: The appeal against the voivode's decision is filed within 14 days of its delivery — to the Head of the Office for Foreigners, via the voivode. After this deadline the decision becomes final, so every day counts.
strings.Mój pobyt jest nielegalny — czy da się t: My stay is illegal — can it be fixed?
strings.W wielu sytuacjach tak — możliwości zale: In many situations yes — the options depend on how the legal stay was lost and how long it has lasted. We analyse the case and look for a further legal solution; the sooner you react, the more options remain open. On withdrawal and expiry of permits: Withdrawal, revocation and expiry of a permit.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> analizuje: How we help: we analyse the files, find the office's errors, prepare appeals and — when needed — a complaint to the administrative court.

strings.Tak, jeśli przystąpił do dobrowolnego ub: Yes, if they opted into voluntary sickness insurance and the 90-day qualifying period has elapsed.
strings.Czy zasiłek macierzyński ma okres wyczek: Does maternity allowance have a qualifying period?
strings.Nie. Zasiłek macierzyński i opiekuńczy p: No. Maternity and care allowance are granted from the first day of being covered by sickness insurance.
strings.Czy zmiana pracodawcy przerywa staż do c: Does changing employer interrupt the service period for sickness allowance?
strings.Poprzednie okresy ubezpieczenia chorobow: Previous periods of sickness insurance count if the break did not exceed 30 days.
strings.Czy okresy pracy w Polsce liczą się do e: Do periods of work in Poland count towards a pension?
strings.Tak, okresy składkowe w polskim ZUS licz: Yes, contribution periods in the Polish ZUS count towards a future retirement or incapacity pension.
strings.Ustawa z 25 czerwca 1999 r. o świadczeni: Act of 25 June 1999 on cash benefits from social insurance in the event of sickness and maternity (the benefits act).
strings.Ustawa z 12 grudnia 2013 r. o cudzoziemc: Act of 12 December 2013 on foreigners (legal residence and access to the labour market).
